acas.name: Acas employment advice
acas.lastSummary: Provider guidance confirms the employment advice service, contact number, weekday hours, free advice with possible phone charges, and interpreter/BSL/relay access.

adhd-uk.name: ADHD UK
adhd-uk.lastSummary: The provider links to online support groups and free tickets with optional donations. Other marketplace services are separate. Detailed eligibility for individual groups was not independently checked.

advice.name: Citizens Advice Harrow
advice.lastSummary: The provider confirms free independent advice, the listed freephone number, weekday hours and web enquiry form. The precise residency rule was not repeated on this contact page.

brent-accessible-travel.name: Brent — accessible travel and transport
brent-accessible-travel.lastSummary: The council lists disability and older-person travel schemes, mobility support and community transport, with application routes and the matching Adult Social Care number. Individual scheme costs and criteria still need checking.

brent-active-together-finder.name: Brent Active Together — activity finder
brent-active-together-finder.lastSummary: The provider describes borough-wide community activity and links to its activity finder. The finder is embedded; individual session prices, availability and booking flows were not tested.

brent-adult-care.name: Brent Adult Social Care
brent-adult-care.lastSummary: The council confirms care, independence and carers support, care-cost guidance and the listed contact number. The online self-assessment route requires a separate check; no change is inferred from its absence on the landing page.

brent-advance.name: Advance — Brent domestic abuse support
brent-advance.lastSummary: The provider confirms the Brent service and contact number, practical safety and rights support, and a separate section supporting men. Confidentiality has stated safeguarding exceptions. No material mismatch was found in these checked fields.

brent-ageuk.name: Age UK Hillingdon, Harrow and Brent
brent-ageuk.lastSummary: The provider confirms support for older people across the named boroughs, free and paid services, and the listed contact number. Individual services retain their own age and locality requirements.

brent-allkind-befriending.name: Allkind — Community Befriending
brent-allkind-befriending.lastSummary: Provider page supports one-to-one community help, Brent adults aged 18+ with mental health needs and isolation, healthcare-professional referral, the listed telephone and funding from £19.75/hour plus extras. It also specifies a minimum two-hour session. No discrepancy found in the checked fields; individual availability and the final charge are not confirmed.

brent-ashford-place.name: Ashford Place — community support
brent-ashford-place.lastSummary: About and Our Approach pages describe community-led social connection, wellbeing and support towards secure housing. The listed telephone and Ask us for help route remain published. Current activities, discharge provision, project eligibility and costs were not specified on these pages.

brent-awrc.name: Asian Women’s Resource Centre
brent-awrc.lastSummary: The provider describes culturally sensitive support for women and girls experiencing abuse across London, with an open-door policy across backgrounds. Multiple support languages and the listed telephone are published. Current capacity, project-specific criteria and costs are not confirmed.

brent-awrc-welfare-advice.name: Asian Women’s Resource Centre — welfare advice
brent-awrc-welfare-advice.lastSummary: The welfare page describes free bilingual benefits, housing and employment advice for women in Brent and Harrow. Individual advice is by appointment; the listed telephone line operates Wednesday afternoons and the enquiry email matches. Current waiting times and language availability are not stated.

brent-barham-community-library.name: Barham Community Library — community activities
brent-barham-community-library.lastSummary: The council listing describes a volunteer-run library and a knitting/sewing group, with contact details and a provider link. Its own update date is 3 June 2024, so present opening times and group availability remain unconfirmed. Costs, booking and adult eligibility are not stated. No discrepancy found in the limited descriptive fields checked.

brent-barn-hill-conservation.name: Barn Hill Conservation Group
brent-barn-hill-conservation.lastSummary: The provider welcomes new volunteers for nature-conservation work in Fryent Country Park and publishes the listed telephone and an email route. A work schedule and meeting-point links are offered. Task accessibility, clothing requirements, costs and individual support are not specified.

brent-benefits.name: Brent benefits and money support
brent-benefits.lastSummary: The council hub lists help with housing costs, Council Tax, bills and benefit applications. Official indexed housing-benefit guidance confirms Brent Hubs can help with council forms. Detailed scheme eligibility and required evidence were not individually checked; no entitlement is implied.

brent-bhcac-dzezva-cafe.name: Café Džezva — 50+ coffee, games and company
brent-bhcac-dzezva-cafe.lastSummary: The provider describes a 50+ cafe open across backgrounds, games and conversation in Willesden, a £2 pay-what-you-feel donation and summer/December breaks. Retrieved versions disagree on Wednesday versus Sunday; the directory deliberately gives no weekday and advises checking the next session. Booking and the cafe-specific email route were not confirmed. No change to the existing cautious wording is supported.

brent-bias-active-ageing.name: Brent Irish Advisory Service — Active Ageing
brent-bias-active-ageing.lastSummary: Council and provider content support the named Irish community organisation and its Active Ageing social activities. The provider describes Active Ageing as supporting older Irish people; the council describes wider services including Irish Travellers. The phone matches. Membership requirements, current lunch-club arrangements, costs and transport were not established from the pages read; the listing appropriately asks callers to check these.

brent-black-girls-do-run.name: Black Girls Do Run UK — North West London
brent-black-girls-do-run.lastSummary: The provider confirms free North West London social running, beginners welcome, and joining through its next-run/Heylo route. Its local programme page explicitly says age 18 and over; the listing omits this. Propose adding the stated age minimum. The next session and individual accessibility still need checking; a phone contact was not published in the material read.

brent-brondesbury-park-synagogue.name: Brondesbury Park United Synagogue
brent-brondesbury-park-synagogue.lastSummary: Brent Council describes the named modern Orthodox Jewish community, welcoming younger and older people and families, and publishes the matching telephone number. The linked provider website could not be read. Visitor arrangements, membership costs, events and accessibility were not established; no change is proposed to the cautious advice to ask the office before attending.

brent-carers-centre.name: Brent Carers Centre
brent-carers-centre.lastSummary: The provider describes support for unpaid adult and young carers in Brent. Its services page supports contacting the centre to register, carers assessments, benefits help and mental health carer support; the phone matches. Current activities, respite availability and any individual costs were not established. The record asks about support rather than promising entitlement or a referral.

brent-changing-mindsets.name: Brent Changing Mindsets — Ashford Place
brent-changing-mindsets.lastSummary: The provider describes a lived-experience-led Brent mental wellbeing group, membership enquiries and members-only Wellbeing Thursdays, consistent with the listing. The contact number matches. Costs, detailed membership eligibility and individual accessibility were not published in the material read; future session availability is not confirmed by this check.

brent-citizens-advice.name: Citizens Advice Brent
brent-citizens-advice.lastSummary: The provider helplines page supports Brent-resident eligibility for the local information and guidance line, the listed phone and Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 10am–4pm hours. It also links to online requests and face-to-face Brent hub advice. The page describes money/debt and Universal Credit routes. It does not clearly state a blanket charge policy for every route; the cost wording has not been fully checked. No discrepancy found in the supported details.

brent-club-brent-sport.name: Disability Sports Coach — Club Brent
brent-club-brent-sport.lastSummary: The provider programme page supports adapted multi-sport at Willesden Sports Centre, the explicit age range of eight and over, involvement of carers and siblings, online booking, and the listed £4 term-time sessions. Although introductory text says all ages, the specific age section states eight and over, matching the directory. Current spaces and individual support requirements are not confirmed; the listing advises checking before booking.

brent-cove.name: Brent Cove
brent-cove.lastSummary: Hestia supports the listed Brent-resident age eligibility, listening/crisis support, appointment-free drop-in and daily 2pm–10pm opening. The page contains conflicting address information between its main contact section and location footer. The directory does not assert an address and already advises calling before travelling; retain that advice. The correct address and individual access needs remain unresolved. No changed crisis contact is proposed or reproduced.

queue.name: Black Girls Do Run UK — North West London
queue.currentValue: Black women and women of colour, including people new to running.
queue.proposedValue: Black women and women of colour aged 18 and over, including people new to running.
queue.reason: Include the explicit minimum age stated on the local programme page so callers can check suitability before joining.
queue.evidence: The North West London programme describes encouraging Black women aged 18 and over to run and welcomes people just starting out.
